parts.label: Part 2
parts.article:
Part two.

You will hear a talk about a summer sports camp for people who are interested in working there.

First, you have some time to look at questions eleven to sixteen.

Now listen carefully and answer questions eleven to sixteen.

Welcome to this talk about the UK Summer Sports Camp. I'm going to tell you about our summer sports camp for children and something about the children who come. Later on, I'll tell you how to apply if you'd like to work with us this year. So please be patient. Feel free to interrupt if there's anything you don't understand about the way the camp is administered, though if you could save any questions about the work itself until the end, that would be good.

The UK Summer Sports Camp offers courses for kids aged six to sixteen, which focus on a wide range of sports and activities.

Our aim is to provide a fun, safe experience for kids.

The reason we're successful is because parents trust us and send their children to us summer after summer. We aren't the cheapest camp around, uh, which might put some people off, but we make sure our team are caring and enthusiastic, and that's why parents want their children to keep coming back rather than because of the facilities on offer. Great as they are, of course.

We think our summer camp is special in a number of ways. We have students from all over the country, not just the local area. We run all the activities you'd expect in a summer camp, arts and music as well as sports, but we also have special coaching for those who might be able to make a career in their chosen sport.

What will your role be if you come and work with us then? We need lots of people who are willing to teach the activities, but we also have non-coaching roles. What we particularly like this summer are people who are willing to be in charge of looking after our younger kids, making sure they're happy and have someone to go to if they have any problems. We usually need a few cooks too, though we don't need anyone extra for our office at the moment.

This year, I'm very pleased to introduce a new role at the camp: camera person. We need someone with great video and photography skills to record the fun everyone has. We'll supply first-class equipment, but we need you to supply your creative abilities. If you're interested in this role, come and talk to me at the end.

Now, you probably want to know about working conditions, hours, and pay. Um, this depends on your role. You can choose to work daytimes, evenings, or weekends. Daytime coaching roles pay the highest wages because of the sports skills required and the longer hours. If you choose to work in the kitchen, your hours of work will be either at breakfast and lunch or at dinner. Cleaners work in the mornings before the camp activities start at ten AM, so not too early.

Before you hear the rest of the talk, you have some time to look at questions seventeen to twenty.

Now listen and answer questions seventeen to twenty.

If you do work with us, there are lots of benefits in addition to the money. Whether you're teaching a sport or not, you'll be given access to all our facilities, which means you can have a swim or play a football match without having to pay anything. We have an Internet cafe where there's a small charge for access, and, uh, we also provide discounted meals in our canteen. We'll give everyone UK summer camp T-shirts, which we'll expect you to wear when working, and if you wish, we also have some cool sports bags which are available for a small fee. So what do we expect from you?

You'll be glad to hear that we don't need to see any formal certificates. If you've worked with kids before, that would be an advantage, but it isn't essential.

Of course, you need to be sociable and enjoy meeting people.

There'll always be a supervisor available who you should talk to before making any important decisions. We can't accept applications from people under the age of eighteen, I'm afraid. But if you haven't got there yet, don't worry. There's always next time.

That is the end of part two. You now have forty-five seconds to check your answers to part two.

questions.question: Why do parents send their children to the camp again and again?

analyses.content: 录音指出家长让孩子反复来是因为我们的团队充满关爱且热情（caring and enthusiastic），这对应选项C的孩子在这里会被好好照顾。
录音明确排除了价格最便宜（aren't the cheapest）以及仅仅因为设施好（rather than because of the facilities）这两个原因，听到这些转折点你要立刻排除A和B。

The reason we're successful is because parents trust us and send their children to us summer after summer. We aren't the cheapest camp around, uh, which might put some people off, but we make sure our team are caring and enthusiastic, and that's why parents want their children to keep coming back rather than because of the facilities on offer. Great as they are, of course.

questions.question: One special thing about this summer camp is

analyses.content: 录音中提到营地为那些可能在所选运动中成为职业选手（make a career）的人提供特别指导，这完美对应选项B的为职业运动做准备。
虽然录音提到了艺术和音乐等非体育活动，但这被描述为大家都能预料到的（you'd expect）常规项目，而不是营地特别的地方，你要紧抓“special coaching”这个信号来排除C。
We run all the activities you'd expect in a summer camp, arts and music as well as sports, but we also have special coaching for those who might be able to make a career in their chosen sport.

录音提到通常需要厨师，但目前办公室不需要额外人手，你要注意听题目问的是今年“特别需要（particularly needs）”的人，从而排除只是“通常需要”的B和“不需要”的A。

questions.question: Which TWO benefits are provided free of charge to camp workers?

analyses.content: 录音提到营地会发给每个人夏令营T恤（give everyone... T-shirts）作为福利，这意味着它是免费提供的，对应选项B。
录音说到T恤时使用了“give everyone”（发给所有人）这样的赠送字眼，没有提到任何费用，你要注意与后面需要少量收费的物品区分开。
We'll give everyone UK Summer Camp T-shirts, which we'll expect you to wear when working.

questions.question: Which TWO benefits are provided free of charge to camp workers?

analyses.content: 录音提到你可以使用所有设施，并且不用支付任何费用（without having to pay anything），直接对应选项C的免费使用体育设施。
录音中明确提到上网吧有少量收费（small charge），餐饮是打折（discounted）而不是免费，运动包也要收一点钱（small fee），听到这些花钱的提示词你要立刻排除A、D和E。

Whether you're teaching a sport or not, you'll be given access to all our facilities, which means you can have a swim or play a football match without having to pay anything. We have an Internet cafe where there's a small charge for access, and, uh, we also provide discounted meals in our canteen. We'll give everyone UK Summer Camp T-shirts, which we'll expect you to wear when working. And if you wish, we also have some cool sports bags which are available for a small fee.

questions.question: Which TWO things do applicants need in order to get a job at the camp?

analyses.content: 录音中明确指出你需要善于交际且喜欢结识朋友（sociable and enjoy meeting people），这对应选项C的友好性格。
录音开头就说不需要看正式证书，且带孩子的经验只是优势而不是必须的（isn't essential），你要抓准“need”（必须）这个硬性要求来排除不满足条件的A和D。

You'll be glad to hear that we don't need to see any formal certificates. If you've worked with kids before, that would be an advantage, but it isn't essential. Of course, you need to be sociable and enjoy meeting people.

questions.question: Which TWO things do applicants need in order to get a job at the camp?

analyses.content: 录音表明营地不接受18岁以下的申请（under the age of eighteen），这意味着申请人必须达到一定年龄，对应选项E。
录音明确要求在做重要决定前要和主管沟通（talk to... before making any important decisions），而不是让你自己独立做决定，你要理清前后的限制条件来排除B。

There'll always be a supervisor available who you should talk to before making any important decisions. We can't accept applications from people under the age of eighteen, I'm afraid. But if you haven't got there yet, don't worry. There's always next time.
